WITH dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT insert_date::DATE AS d
    FROM city_legislation.main.cities
    WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn' AND insert_date LIKE '2021-07-%'
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT d,
           d - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d) * INTERVAL '1 day' AS grp
    FROM dates
),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT grp, COUNT(*) as len, MIN(d) as start_date, MAX(d) as end_date
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY grp
),
min_max_len AS (
    SELECT MIN(len) as min_len, MAX(len) as max_len
    FROM streak_lengths
),
target_streaks AS (
    SELECT grp
    FROM streak_lengths, min_max_len
    WHERE len = min_len OR len = max_len
),
target_dates AS (
    SELECT d
    FROM streaks
    WHERE grp IN (SELECT grp FROM target_streaks)
)
SELECT t.d AS date,
       CONCAT(UPPER(SUBSTRING(MIN(c.city_name), 1, 1)), LOWER(SUBSTRING(MIN(c.city_name), 2))) AS city_name
FROM target_dates t
JOIN city_legislation.main.cities c ON t.d = c.insert_date::DATE
WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
GROUP BY t.d
ORDER BY t.d;

),
streak_lengths AS (
    SELECT grp, COUNT(*) as len
    FROM streaks
    GROUP BY grp
),
min_max_len AS (
    SELECT MIN(len) as min_len, MAX(len) as max_len
    FROM streak_lengths
),
target_streaks AS (
    SELECT grp
    FROM streak_lengths, min_max_len
    WHERE len = min_len OR len = max_len
),
target_dates AS (
    SELECT d
    FROM streaks
    WHERE grp IN (SELECT grp FROM target_streaks)
)
SELECT t.d AS date,
       CONCAT(UPPER(SUBSTRING(MIN(c.city_name), 1, 1)), LOWER(SUBSTRING(MIN(c.city_name), 2))) AS city_name
FROM target_dates t
JOIN city_legislation.main.cities c ON t.d = c.insert_date::DATE
WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
